doc: FBL 0.11, section 4.9 (Escapes), FR-005: a quoted argument read and written with the slot's escape. "The \"user\"" reads The "user", and "A path C:\temp and a \"quote\"." keeps the backslash that escapes nothing. A set to Parity "name" writes every quote escaped, and is not refused; a set to a value holding a line break is refused by the family's read-again check, and nothing is written. The input is etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/c4/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.C4.Tests/Fixtures/findings/escaped-quote.dsl at ad1a4680a, byte for byte.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
A set's value is written with every quote escaped, between the two quotes the slot's requote gives, in place of the whole argument (FBL 0.15 6.3, A string).
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
A value holding a line break cannot be written in a one-line string: the entry would not read back with it, so the set is refused and nothing is written (FBL 4.9, Writing).
steps.refused: The new name would not read back from the workspace.
